title: UK government issues mental health guidance for nationals in Argentina
excerpt: The guidance outlines emergency procedures and local support services for British nationals experiencing mental health difficulties in Argentina.
bodyHtml:
The UK government published guidance on October 22, 2026, for British nationals in Argentina regarding access to mental health support. The document provides information on emergency contacts, medical facilities, and the process for accessing both inpatient and outpatient care within the country.

For urgent medical attention, the government advises calling 911 or 107 for an ambulance. The guidance notes that public hospitals provide emergency treatment regardless of a patient's ability to pay, though costs for follow-up care or non-emergency services may apply.

The document also lists several local organizations, such as the suicide prevention helpline Centro de Asistencia al Suicida, which can be reached at 135 from Buenos Aires City and Greater Buenos Aires. Additionally, the guidance states that individuals may find it difficult to find certain medicines in Argentina and should bring at least enough to last for their stay.
